module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 0) that reads and writes small JSON save files specific to flowgraph projects. The files are stored under 'settings/cloud/flowgraphSaveData' + name + '.save.json' with the structure {lastModified, data}. The files are loaded on demand, cached, and rewritten to disk at the end of the tick (afterTrigger) if they were modified.
notes: The path is built by simple concatenation savePath .. file .. ext: the name 'file' must therefore start with '/' to get a correct path.
If the JSON read has no data field, its entire content is wrapped in {lastModified = 0, data = <content>}.
The cache is cleared when the project starts and stops.

init.desc: Called when the module is created: calls clear().

clear.desc: Clears the file cache and the list of modified files.

forceReload.desc: Forgets the cached file; it will be re-read on next access.

file.desc: file name (without folder prefix or extension)

getFile.desc: Returns the file's {lastModified, data} table, loading it from disk (or creating an empty table) on the first request.

write.desc: Writes a value into data[field], updates lastModified (os.time()) and marks the file to be saved.

afterTrigger.desc: Called after the graph tick: writes each modified file to disk (jsonWriteFile) and clears the modification list.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: calls clear().

executionStarted.desc: Called when the project starts: calls clear().
